Thin-Crust Pizza Dough for 4 Balls

Thin-Crust Pizza Dough for 4 balls uses 55% water, no starter, 2% salt, and 0.4% yeast. Four balls at 200 g each come to 800 g. Divide the dough in half, then divide each half. This stiffer dough rolls thin. Dock it with a fork if a bubble would lift the toppings.

Percentages are of the flour you weigh out, and effective hydration also counts the flour and water inside a starter that is itself 100% hydration.

Enter a flour weight above zero, or a ball count and grams per ball above zero. Percentages cannot be negative.
